id: title:Piccirello:validate token user status on bearer auth paths

review.posthog_relevance: Adds authentication and authorization checks for OAuth provisioning and team access, potentially preventing unauthorized access when users are deactivated or removed from teams.
review.reason: The chunk includes implementation changes in P1.F11.H3 and P1.F11.H4 that add checks for team existence and access, alongside P1.F12.H1 which checks user activity status. P1.F1.H2 also adds checks for deactivated users. While P1.F1.H2 and P1.F12.H1 are noted as not changing implementation or adding only tests, P1.F11.H3 and P1.F11.H4 represent substantive additions to the access-re
review.uncertainty: The chunk does not include the implementation of the helper function `user_can_access_team` or the complete OAuth token introspection and revocation changes, so the full behavior and validation cannot be verified. The tier is assigned based on the observed implementation changes, not the complete system behavior.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Type annotation change: return type of ProvisioningBearerAuthentication.authenticate changed from tuple[User | None, OAuthAccessToken] to tuple[User, OAuthAccessToken].
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk does not change the implementation; it only changes the type annotation. The actual authentication and authorization checks are not performed here. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds checks for deactivated users and missing users in ProvisioningBearerAuthentication.authenticate, raising ProvisioningError with status 401.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks whether the authenticated user exists and is active. If not, authentication fails. This could prevent unauthorized access if a user account is deactivated while an OAuth token remains valid. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a test for refresh token rejection when the user is deactivated.
observations.posthog_connection: This hunk does not change implementation; it only adds a test. No score assigned.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the helper function `user_can_access_team` referenced in P1.F11.H3, nor does it include the implementation of the OAuth token introspection and revocation changes. While the chunk adds checks and tests, the actual enforcement and the complete behavior of the helper cannot be verified. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a re-check of team access after fetching the team, removing a TODO about a latent bug. P1.F11.H3: P1.F11.H4: P1.F13.H1: P1.F13.H2
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the team exists and re-validates access, potentially closing a gap where a token could retain access after the user is removed from the team.

observations.behavior: Adds a call to the new access check after resolving the team. P1.F11.H4
observations.posthog_connection: Re-checks access for the team, potentially closing a gap where a token could retain access after the user is removed from the team.

observations.behavior: Adds a test for token introspection reflecting user status. P1.F12.H1
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the token's user is active, potentially closing a gap where a token could retain access after the user is removed from the team.
